newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-UEFA BAN ALBANIAN CLUBS, OPEN THE DOOR TO ANDORRA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UEFA BAN ALBANIAN CLUBS, OPEN THE DOOR TO ANDORRA.

text.p: Albanian clubs will not be allowed to compete in next season's European club competitions because of the current situation in the country, UEFA said on Friday.

A statement issued by European soccer's governing body explained that UEFA had "examined the current political troubles and the situation of football in Albania and came to the conclusion that, for the time being, the staging of international matches in Albania would not be appropriate."

Partizani Tirana were due to take part in the European Cup Winners' Cup after beating Flamurtari in the cup final on May 3, but most soccer in the country has come to a standstill since the league championship was suspended with 17 rounds to play in January.

UEFA also announced that for the first time clubs from the tiny principality of Andorra would take part in their competitions, with the exception of FC Andorra who play in the lower reaches of the Spanish league.
